title: Changelog - November 2024
text:
## Changelog - November 2024
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102569
New Features:
We created a new widget called "Bootstrap Theme - Cookie Consent Code". The code in this new widget is executed before all scripts in the <head> of all pages of a site. This is ideal for adding the code from any Cookie Consent script provider that requires to run before all other scripts that may set cookies on the page.
We added the ability to upload SVG image files in Froala WYSIWYG editors in the Admin and on the Frontend.
We updated the Brilliant Directories Zapier App to not require the Lead Status and Lead Email fields when updating Leads using the App. Additionally, we implemented a set of minor fixes to the triggers logic using the Zapier App.
We released a new version of the Brilliant Directories Zapier a pp to include include triggers for all new items created (member, lead, review, unsubscribed, post).
